Chapter 1439 - 13: Dim And Dark Future (2)

Chapter 1439 - 13: Dim and Dark Future (2)

The main battle of the lord's physical form not only signifies a dedication of heart and blood but also embodies numerous secrets of the self. To redeem the main battle physical form, the owner of the form is sure to be willing to purchase at a 'premium'.

...

Just as Lin Yuan put away the bodies of the Blood Sea Lord and others, examining the spoils.

A group of Time Lords watched this scene with their eyes wide open, not daring to make a single move.

Every Time Lord knew that the three bodies of the Blood Sea Lord and others contained immense wealth.

But no Time Lord dared to take advantage of the opportunity, for just now, the white jade staircase Lin Yuan summoned, and the figure on the staircase with its back to them, which with a wave of a sleeve extinguished both the current and future form of the Blood Sea Lord, left a deep imprint on every Time Lord's soul, never to be forgotten.

With the Blood Sea Lord as a precedent, who would dare to make a move at this time?

"Such a dignified Blood Sea Lord, just died like that? The main battle physical form died within the Wanwei dimension?"

A Time Lord murmured, as if in a dream.

The obliteration of the Blood Sea Lord across all timelines, even the Legendary Lords found it difficult to perceive, thus many Time Lords on the scene only believed that the Blood Sea Lord had lost a main battle physical form.

Even so, it was extremely baffling.

"Not only did the Blood Sea Lord fall, but so did his future form, the one that had stepped into the legendary level future form."

"Which Lord could it be? With such terrifying future strength, reaching the final stage of the three hundred and thirty million tribulations, to what degree? The two hundred millionth tribulation? Or the three hundred millionth?"

The more each Time Lord thought, the more shocked they became, unable to calm their minds for a long time.

Time Lords walk every step on the edge of life and death, more so for the Legendary Lords. To possess greater strength, one must endure more tribulations, and every tribulation comes with the risk of falling.

...

Within the vast dimensional gaps.

In a palace hidden within a special space.

The true body of the Tianshi Lord opened his eyes, showing an incredible expression.

"The Blood Sea Lord summoned his future form which had stepped into the legendary level, and suppressed my main battle physical form. Later, a lord watching on the side also summoned a future form that casually wiped away the Blood Sea Lord's present and future forms?"

The Tianshi Lord blinked, and through a Time Lord nearby, he understood what happened after he was suppressed.

It was truly a turn of events.

"The future of that observing lord..."

The Tianshi Lord found it unbelievable. He had personally faced the future form of the Blood Sea Lord, and although ultimately suppressed, he understood the terrifying methods of the opponent.

Such an existence could also be casually erased?

"My main battle physical form fell into the hands of that observing lord?"

The Tianshi Lord couldn't help but feel a headache. If his main battle physical form fell into the hands of the Blood Sea Lord, the Tianshi Lord would be troubled but could roughly understand the price needed to redeem it.

But falling into the hands of this mysterious lord?

The Tianshi Lord knew nothing about this mysterious lord, and the terrifying future of the other party made him very uneasy, having no idea how to 'redeem' his main battle physical form?

If the price is too high? He might not be able to afford it.

If it's too low? It could provoke the other party, leading to an unpleasant outcome.

"No matter what, I still have to try."

The Tianshi Lord steadied himself, realizing that his main battle physical form could not remain outside. Even if it costs him greatly, he had to try to 'redeem' it.

...

In the deepest part of the Wanwei dimension.

When the Blood Sea Lord summoned his future form, it alarmed several existences here.

When it involves the third level Legendary Lord's power, it can be perceived no matter how far away.

"Another Legendary Lord."

"Is it a Legendary Lord from the future?"

"Acting in the present dimension, is it laying out pieces or mending his own hidden dangers?"

The few Legendary Lords in the deepest part of the Wanwei dimension didn't pay too much attention.

Legendary Lords occasionally act in past dimensions, which isn't too surprising.

As long as there isn't too much impact caused, other Legendary Lords are too lazy to intervene since a future Legendary Lord acting in the present is akin to a present Legendary Lord acting in the past.

"Is it Blood Sea... that guy became a legend in the future?"

Several Legendary Lords observed from afar, discussing amongst themselves.

The future seen by the Legendary Lords is mostly vague and dark, especially when it involves other Legendary Lords.

Each Legendary Lord walks deep on the path of transcendence, related to transcendence, and is difficult to observe.

Immediately following.

As Lin Yuan began to summon his future form.

Every Legendary Lord's expression changed.

"What is this?"

"This suppression of time and space impact?"

Numerous Legendary Lords wore grave expressions, and several others, still in a state of understanding, also awoke, gazing towards the direction where the timeline was tangled.

An endless white jade staircase.

A figure climbing step by step, with its back to all beings.

The scene of a sleeve wave wiping out both the present and future form of the Blood Sea Lord.

Within a few brief breaths, everything that happened left the Legendary Lords breathless.

"Instantly obliterated, even the future legendary form of the Blood Sea Lord couldn't withstand it? Acting at different time segments, the power would naturally be suppressed and limited, yet still reached such a level, the strength of this existence..."

"Definitely not inferior to the existence of Lord Wanwei, probably almost explored the end of a path of transcendence."

"Who exactly is it? And that white jade staircase, never seen before, is it from some dimensional space?"

The numerous Legendary Lords' spirits were continuously shaken. They were not very concerned about the future legendary form of the Blood Sea Lord because they were basically on the same level, or even superior.

But the figure on the endless white jade staircase, the wide dimensional gaps, Legendary Lords generally don't reveal their tracks, but such a powerful Legendary Lord, even likely surpassing Lord Wanwei's Legendary Lord...

"This terrifying existence of future time and space, is his past form?"

The numerous Legendary Lords cast their gaze toward Lin Yuan from afar, secretly surprised: "Not a lord, yet possessing strength close to the extreme of the second level..."

"One cannot know how many years removed this terrifying existence is from the future."

"Regardless of how many years into the future, such strength presumes not many exist within the vast dimensional gaps."

"Indeed, even counting those hidden 'old antiques', there may not be many that compare with this one."

A quick exchange between the Legendary Lords in the deepest Wanwei dimension.

Does the current Wanwei dimension have any Legendary Lords comparable or even surpassing the Wanwei Lord?

Indeed, it does exist.

But it's extremely rare.

Legendary Lords of such heights, about to see the end of a path to transcendence, seldom divert their attention unless it concerns their transcendence.

"That white jade staircase?"

A Legendary Lord emitting purple light wore a serious expression, glancing at the other Legendary Lords: "Recently, in the future we observed, from ten thousand to a million years later, there is a period when the timeline is incredibly dark and obscure, difficult to observe any information..."

The future timeline observed by Time Lords is largely vague and dark, referring to the information they wish to know being vague and dark.

As for the intricate future images—related to other time beings and ordinary Time Lords, some fragments can still be viewed.

After all, it doesn't involve transcendence, or hasn't contacted too much with transcendence...

However, what the present Legendary Lords saw in the future timeline, from ten thousand to a million years later, was uniformly in an incredibly obscure state?

It means that in ten thousand to a million years, a significant event affecting the vast dimensional gaps will occur, likely related to transcendence, resulting in such observations amongst these Legendary Lords.

"You mean that white jade staircase is related to the future obscurity we observed?"

Another Legendary Lord looked contemplative.

"Indeed."

The purple light Legendary Lord nodded and continued: "I'm merely speculating."
